page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance type belonging to the ecs.gn5 family. It features 54 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The instance is equipped with 480.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 8.89 GB of RAM per core. This hardware configuration runs on the KVM hypervisor.

This server integrates eight NVIDIA P100 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 128 GB of GPU VRAM. For local data storage, the instance includes 3779 GB of bundled local SSD storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps.

The CPU architecture lacks support for several modern instruction sets, including AVX-512, AMX, and SHA extensions. Additionally, the lack of hyperthreading limits concurrent thread execution to one thread per physical core. However, the high density of eight dedicated GPUs combined with substantial local SSD storage makes this instance suitable for legacy GPU-accelerated workloads, parallel compute tasks, deep learning training, and database operations requiring high-speed local storage.
